function shrinkSolar(d): SFBodyDef

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/catalog/geo.ts:70

Solar-tier shrink — every AU-scale body authored below is diagram-size (a 12-unit Sun would mass 1 200 ly at the galactic tier — bigger than honestly-scaled dwarf spheroidals). Multiplying the whole tier by SF_SCALE.SOLAR_SCALE lands the Sun's drawn disc at 0.024 units — under Proxima's true 0.042-unit distance, so no star renders inside the photosphere — and the whole system inside ~0.23 units, honest ordering against the stellar neighbourhood at the cost of planet specks that only the fly-to/zoom tier reveals. radius, orbit, belt bounds and satellites all shrink together so internal proportions stay authored. Exported so coverage tails can pin every arm — no current solar def carries satellites, but the arm keeps a future moon-bearing def honest.

d
